questions.question: Who has been reappointed as the MD & CEO of IDBI Bank for another three-year term starting March 19, 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Rakesh Sharma.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Rakesh Sharma has been reappointed as MD & CEO of IDBI Bank for a three-year term starting March 19, 2025.**
 
• The decision was approved by the Board of Directors on January 23, 2025, with the Reserve Bank of India’s approval.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sharma’s career spans over four decades, starting with SBI, where he excelled in credit, HR, and international banking operations.**
 
• He served as MD & CEO of Lakshmi Vilas Bank (2014-2015) and Canara Bank (2015-2018).
 
• As MD & CEO of IDBI Bank since 2018, he has driven operational and financial transformation.
 
• He also holds leadership roles in EDII, IBA, IDBI Capital Markets, and IDBI Intech Limited.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• IDBI Bank__

 __
 
• Founded in 1964 as the Industrial Development Bank of India.
 
• Currently a subsidiary of LIC (Life Insurance Corporation of India).
 
• Headquartered in Mumbai.
 
 
 
• Rakesh Sharma’s Leadership__
 __
 
• His focus has been on sustainable growth, operational efficiency, and innovation.
 
• He has strengthened IDBI Bank's financial stability and overall performance during his tenure.
 
 
 
• Related Organizations__
 
 
• **EDII**: Entrepreneurship Development Institute of India.
 
• **IBA**: Indian Banks’ Association, which represents banking institutions in India.
 
• **IDBI Intech Limited**: A technology subsidiary of IDBI Bank.

questions.question: Who has been named the chairperson of the Indian Weightlifting Federation (IWLF) Athletes' Commission? (April 2025)
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Mirabai Chanu.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Mirabai Chanu, Olympic silver medallist, has been named the chairperson of the IWLF Athletes' Commission.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Mirabai Chanu, an Olympic silver medallist and decorated weightlifter, was appointed the chairperson of the IWLF Athletes’ Commission.
 
• Her personal best lift is 205kg, which includes the national record in snatch (88kg) and clean and jerk (119kg).
 
• She pledged to represent and amplify the athletes' voice, ensuring focus on the sport without external distractions.
 
• **S. Sathish Kumar, who won gold at the Commonwealth Games, was elected as the vice-chairperson for a four-year term.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Mirabai Chanu__

 __
 
• She is India’s most decorated weightlifter, with multiple records and a history-making silver medal at the Tokyo 2020 Olympics.
 
• Mirabai became the first Indian weightlifter to win gold at the World Weightlifting Championships in 2017 after a 22-year gap.
 
 
 
• S. Sathish Kumar__
 
 
• Sathish Kumar clinched gold in weightlifting at the 2018 Commonwealth Games, lifting a total of 317kg.
 
• He won his second consecutive Commonwealth Games gold after securing the title in Glasgow in 2014.

questions.question: Sukanya Sonowal, a final-year B Tech student from the _______________, has been appointed to the Executive Committee of the Commonwealth Youth Peace Ambassadors Network (CYPAN).
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Guwahati**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• IIT Guwahati student appointed as Commonwealth youth peace ambassador.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Sukanya Sonowal**, a **final-year B.Tech student** from **IIT Guwahati**, has been appointed to the **Executive Committee** of the **Commonwealth Youth Peace Ambassadors Network (CYPAN)**.

 
 
• 
 
She will serve as the **Lead for Communications and Public Relations** for the **2025–2027** term.

 
 
• 
 
**CYPAN** is a **youth-led initiative** active in **56 Commonwealth nations**, promoting **peace** and **countering violent extremism** through **dialogue**, **community service**, and **outreach**.

 
 
• 
 
Sonowal is originally from **Lakhimpur district, Assam**.

 
 
• 
 
At **IIT Guwahati**, she was involved in **outreach and communications**, including work on the **media and branding team of Techniche**, the institute’s techno-management festival.

 
 
• 
 
She is the **co-founder of “STEMvibe – STEM for Viksit Bharat Empowerment”**, a **nationwide initiative** that has reached over **3,000 students**.

 
 
• 
 
She also leads **“The Integral Cup”**, a **mathematics competition** for undergraduates, which saw **2,500+ participants** in its first edition.

questions.question: Who has been declared the president for Syria's transitional phase, consolidating his power after toppling Bashar al-Assad? (January 2025)
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Ahmed al-Sharaa**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Ahmed al-Sharaa has been declared president for Syria's transitional phase after leading a campaign that ousted Bashar al-Assad.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ahmed al-Sharaa was appointed as Syria's president for a transitional phase, following his leadership in the campaign that overthrew Bashar al-Assad.**
 
• The new administration aims to establish a transitional government, a new constitution, and hold elections within four years.
 
• The Syrian constitution was suspended, and the military-led council was empowered to form a temporary legislative body.
 
• Sharaa's leadership aims to rebuild state institutions, preserve civil peace, and ensure the development of Syria's economic infrastructure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Hayat Tahrir al-Sham (HTS)__

 __
 
• HTS is an Islamist group that emerged from Al-Qaeda's Nusra Front, which had been involved in the Syrian civil war.
 
• HTS has played a significant role in the Syrian conflict and was instrumental in the removal of Bashar al-Assad's regime.
 
 
 
• Bashar al-Assad__
 __
 
• Assad is the former president of Syria, whose regime was overthrown during the Syrian revolution.
 
• Assad’s government faced opposition from various rebel factions during the Syrian civil war.
 
 
 
• Qatar's Role in Syria__
 
 
• Qatar supported the new administration led by Sharaa, welcoming the restructuring of the Syrian state and fostering unity among its factions.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the new Chairman and Managing Director (CMD) of National Mineral Development Corporation?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Amitava Mukherjee.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Amitava Mukherjee has been appointed as the new CMD of NMDC, effective from March 6, 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Amitava Mukherjee was previously holding the additional charge of CMD at NMDC.**
 
• The appointment is for the period from March 6, 2025, to February 29, 2028, or until further orders.
 
• He has been appointed as CMD by the Board of NMDC, as confirmed in an exchange filing.
 
• NMDC is a state-owned iron ore mining company, and the CMD appointment plays a key role in its strategic operations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• NMDC (National Mineral Development Corporation)__

 __
 
• NMDC is India's largest iron ore producer and exporter, operating mainly in the Chhattisgarh and Karnataka states.
 
• The company plays a significant role in the mining and metal industry, contributing to India’s economy.
 
 
 
• Chairman and Managing Director (CMD)__
 __
 
• The CMD of a company is the top executive responsible for the day-to-day operations and decision-making of the organization.
 
• The appointment of a new CMD marks a strategic shift and direction for the company’s future growth and operations.
 
 
 
• Amitava Mukherjee__
 
 
• Amitava Mukherjee has been part of NMDC and has now officially taken the role of CMD to steer the company’s strategic decisions.
 
• His leadership will focus on further enhancing the company's performance in the mining sector.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the new Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) of India in February 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Gyanesh Kumar.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Gyanesh Kumar has been appointed as the new Chief Election Commissioner, replacing Rajiv Kumar.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gyanesh Kumar is a 1988-batch IAS officer from the Kerala cadre, and he replaces Rajiv Kumar as the Chief Election Commissioner.**
 
• The appointment was made following a selection process involving Prime Minister Narendra Modi and other senior leaders.
 
• This is the first appointment of the CEC under the Chief Election Commissioner and Other Election Commissioner Act, 2023.
 
• Gyanesh Kumar's appointment follows the retirement of Rajiv Kumar, who led the Commission from May 2022.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Chief Election Commissioner (CEC)__

 __
 
• The CEC is the head of the Election Commission of India, overseeing the administration and conduct of elections in the country.
 
• The CEC is appointed for a fixed tenure and plays a crucial role in ensuring free and fair elections.
 
 
 
• Election Commissioner__
 __
 
• Election Commissioners work alongside the CEC and help manage the electoral process, with a focus on policy, planning, and execution.
 
• The Election Commission is a constitutional body tasked with administering elections in India at the central and state levels.
 
 
 
• Rajiv Kumar__
 __
 
• Rajiv Kumar served as the 25th CEC and oversaw key elections including the 2024 Lok Sabha elections.
 
• He was credited for implementing reforms and ensuring peaceful elections during his tenure.
 
 
 
• The Chief Election Commissioner and Other Election Commissioner Act, 2023__
 
 
• This Act outlines the process of appointing and managing Election Commissioners and the CEC, ensuring an independent and impartial electoral body.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://ddnews.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/Gyanesh-kumar-1.jpg]

questions.question: Under which Article of the Constitution did Vice President Jagdeep Dhankhar resign?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Article 67(a)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Vice President Jagdeep Dhankhar resigns citing health reasons.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Vice President Jagdeep Dhankhar** resigned on **Monsoon Session Day 1**, citing **health concerns**.

 
 
• 
 
Resignation submitted to **President Droupadi Murmu**, effective **immediately** under **Article 67(a)** of the Constitution.

 
 
• 
 
Also stepped down as **Chairman of the Rajya Sabha**.

 
 
• 
 
His resignation letter stressed the need to **prioritise health** and follow **medical advice**.
